projectDescription: Player Forged is an MLB-inspired, at-home baseball training app that delivers position-specific drill programs for athletes of all skill levels, with built-in video review, team roster management, and a practice calendar to help coaches coordinate supplemental training.
keyFeatures: Position-specific drill programs for Pitcher, Catcher, Infielder, Outfielder, Hitter, Base Running, and Speed & Conditioning
Four skill levels: Beginner (Ages 7–10), Developing (Ages 11–13), Intermediate (Ages 14–18), and Advanced (18+)
Phased training progression with clear 'move on when' milestones
Built-in video review tool with side-by-side comparison and slow-motion/frame-stepping controls
Self-review checklists that reset daily to encourage consistent practice habits
Sticker reward system that awards collectible stickers every 5 completed drills
Team roster management with per-athlete training assignments
Practice calendar with coach and player views to coordinate team vs. solo training
Custom drill builder for coaches to add their own content to any focus/level
Team branding (name, colors, logo) applied across the entire app
Export/import system for sharing training files between coaches and athletes
Equipment tracker with automatic bodyweight-friendly substitutions for missing gear
Age-specific rest and off-season program guidance
Fully offline — all data stays on device, nothing uploaded anywhere
publicApiSurface: Training focuses: pitcher, catcher, infielder, outfielder, hitter, baserunning, conditioning
